allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Police officer Asger Holm, demoted to desk work as an alarm dispatcher, answers a call from a panicked woman who claims to have been kidnapped. Confined to the police station and with the phone as his only tool, Asger races against time to get help and find her.

facts.title: The Guilty

semanticBoundaryFlags.message: The confined phone-based emergency could be argued as immersive, but the packet only securely supports engaged attention.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With only a phone line linking him to a panicked victim, can a desk-bound dispatcher piece together the truth in time to save her?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Demoted to emergency dispatch duty, police officer Asger Holm answers a call from an abducted woman. Confined to his desk, he must rely entirely on the phone line to orchestrate a rescue.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and emotionally heavy, this claustrophobic suspense drama demands focused attention in an intense solo watch.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Gustav Möller delivers a tight 85-minute Danish thriller that turns an isolated desk into an urgent, high-stakes crime drama driven purely by vocal cues.
